maxFailures.description: Cases with status fail a suite may have. Default 0.

allowUnmeasured.description: Whether a suite may have unmeasured cases and thresholds. Default false: unmeasured is never a pass.

latencyP50Ms.description: The median latency of the answered turns, every sample included (ADR-0014).

latencyP95Ms.description: The 95th percentile latency of the answered turns, every sample included.

costPerTurnUsd.description: The mean model cost of an answered turn, from the model proxy.

costUsd.description: The suite's total model cost, from the model proxy.

suites.description: Overrides per suite of the thresholds above.

prices.description: Per upstream id, per model as the provider reports it (ADR-0012). A model without a price has no cost.

cachedInput.description: Defaults to the input price, so cost is never understated.
